The browser window 'beforeunload' add/removeEventListener (L336-349) is replaced by a guarded globalThis lifecycle probe (getGlobalLifecycle) so it still fires the broadcastReleased hint on the react-native-web build and is a safe no-op on pure native; the typeof window guard intent is preserved.

L376-398 __resetEditLeasesForTests ported verbatim: clears each entry's electionTimer, calls+nulls unsubscribeBus in try/catch, clears subscribers, then leases.clear().

Browser-only dependency handling (contract rule 7): @/lib/broadcast is DOM-only (BroadcastChannel/localStorage/window). Replaced with an inline native-safe bus — stable TAB_ID via a bitwise-free Math.random v4-shaped id (mirrors the web safeUUID Math.random fallback, no Web Crypto needed on RN), a lease-only BroadcastMessage union (the only variants this hook uses), and an EditLeaseTransport seam. The default transport AUTO-DETECTS a global BroadcastChannel (structurally typed like the automationSSE EventSource port) with the same _from:TAB_ID envelope + self-filter as the web bus so the react-native-web browser build keeps real cross-tab parity; otherwise it is a documented no-op. EDIT_LEASE_BUS_UNAVAILABLE_REASON is exported as the explicit unavailable state and setEditLeaseTransport lets a host (or test) inject real fanout — mirroring the useAchievementCelebrationPrefs injectable-seam + automationSSE unavailable-reason precedents.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components imported — only react. DOM globals (BroadcastChannel, window/addEventListener) are reached only through guarded globalThis casts (RN tsconfig omits the DOM lib). Formatting matches repo prettier (single quotes, trailing commas, no bracket spacing, arrowParens avoid) and @react-native eslint (curly braces on all ifs, eqeqeq-smart != null). Verified via: cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
